title: rev. 1.209: the O2 debt counter read prose and was silently wrong
head: fix/o37DebtCounter
body:
Repairs , which read **4** against a true debt of **0**.

**The reasoning is not in this description.**  is the single point of truth (O36). Revision log rev. 1.209; O37 amended in §G.2b.

## Why it was wrong

It pattern-matched English. Three mechanisms, all live: a match on a phrase meaning the *opposite* of a debt; a match on prose describing **its own fault injection**; and a match on a debt already discharged. Root cause: it read the revision log — history by definition — as current state.

**And it did not fire.** 4 < 15, so it looked healthy. The rev. 1.207 injection proved it *fires*, not that it fires on the *right thing*.

## The repair

Debt is carried by the token  at the **start** of a Change cell; discharge by . Positional, so prose about the convention cannot be counted as an instance of it.

Fault-injected in **three** directions: tokened debt warns and names every revision; the same rows below a discharge stay silent; and the three old false positives, replayed, stay silent. The third is the one that matters — it tests the defect rather than the feature.

Also discharges O2 for revs. 1.205–1.208 on runs 99 and 100.

> **PREDICTED FOR RUN 101 — 598: 596 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped by design, 0 unexpected.**
